REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-54110  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Commission for Women and Girls
  meeting of Wednesday, December 18, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  girls affected by the fires.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Allen Harper, seconded by Vice Chair
  Nicholson, to approve recommendation, as amended, that Vice Chair
